BillingPeriod.description: The billing period for an invoice.

endDate.description: The end of the billing period of an invoice.

startDate.description: The start of the billing period of an invoice.

Breakdown.description: Details about the movement of money.

breakdownAmount.description: The monetary amount of the charge.

breakdowns.description: A list of breakdowns that detail how the total amount is calculated.

Currency.description: A monetary amount with a currency code.

currencyCode.description: The three-digit currency code in ISO 4217 format.

Error.description: Error response returned when the request is unsuccessful.

code.description: An error code that identifies the type of error that occurred.

details.description: Additional details that can help the caller understand or fix the issue.

message.description: A message that describes the error condition.

ErrorList.description: A list of error responses returned when a request is unsuccessful.

errors.description: Error response returned when the request is unsuccessful.

invoiceItems.description: A list of invoice line items.

nextTokenForLineItems.description: A token you can use to retrieve the next page of line items.

invoices.description: A list of invoices with header-level details.

nextToken.description: The response includes `nextToken` when the number of invoices exceeds the default page size value.

InvoiceHeader.description: Represents the header-level information for an invoice, including parties involved (payer/payee), financial amounts, status, dates, and related business identifiers.

billingPeriod.description: The billing period for an invoice.

dueDate.description: The due date of the invoice.

invoiceAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the invoice.

invoiceAmountBreakdowns.description: The breakdown of the invoice amount into sub-components.

invoiceIdentifier.description: The unique identifier for an invoice.

invoiceNumber.description: The invoice number provided when the invoice was created.

invoiceSettlementBreakdowns.description: The breakdown of the invoice settlement amount into sub-components.

invoiceStatus.description: The current state of the invoice.

lastUpdatedDate.description: When the invoice was last updated.

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms associated with the invoice.

relatedIdentifiers.description: A list of related business identifiers associated with the invoice.

InvoiceItem.description: A line item within an invoice, including unit costs, quantities, tax information, and contextual details about the goods or services being invoiced.

lineItemContext.description: Contextual information about the line item.

lineItemId.description: The unique identifier for the line item.

quantity.description: The number of units for the line item.

relatedItemIdentifiers.description: List of related item identifiers for the line item.

taxRateCodes.description: A list of country code and tax rate combinations applied to the line item.

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount for the line item, including tax.

totalAmountBreakdown.description: The breakdown of the total amount into sub-components.

unitCost.description: The cost per unit of the line item.

ItemIdentifier.description: Identifier for an item in the invoice line item.

itemIdentifierValue.description: The value of the item identifier.

LineItemContext.description: Contextual information about an invoice line item.

itemIdentifiers.description: A list of identifiers for the item.

matchingContext.description: Information related to matching of invoiced quantity with Amazon systems.

MatchingContext.description: How an invoice line item's quantity and price were matched against expected values, including any variances and their underlying reasons.

matchedAmount.description: The monetary amount that was matched.

paidAmount.description: The monetary amount that has been paid.

paidQuantity.description: The quantity that has been paid for.

priceVariance.description: The difference between expected and actual price.

quantityVariance.description: The difference between expected and actual quantity.

PartnerMetadata.description: Metadata about a partner (payer or payee) associated with the invoice.

partnerEntities.description: The list of entities associated with a partner.

partnerId.description: The unique identifier for the partner.

taxRegistrationNumber.description: The tax registration number of the partner.

RelatedIdentifier.description: Related business identifier of the transaction.

relatedIdentifierName.description: The name of the related identifier.

ServiceChargePeriod.description: The time period for a service charge.

endDate.description: When the service charge period ends.

startDate.description: When the service charge period starts.

VarianceReason.description: The type and underlying defect classifications explaining discrepancies between expected and actual invoice values.

defectTypes.description: List of defect types associated with the variance.
